activities.caption: place the founding device on the century scale
activities.name: spcShewhartPlace

config.prompt: Walter Shewhart's control chart arrived in which year?
config.why: A simple statistical device separated common-cause variation — the process's natural breathing — from special cause, something that changed and should be hunted down; applied relentlessly, that distinction built the modern quality profession.

activities.anchor: Quality statistics is built on a small set of distributions
activities.caption: pair each distribution with the variation it models
activities.name: spcDistMatch

config.prompt: Match the distribution to the kind of variation:

pairs.right: continuous measurements — fill volumes, dimensions, weights
literally a specification six standard deviations wide

config.why: The area fractions — about 68 per cent within ±1σ, 95 within ±2σ, 99.7 within ±3σ — are the control chart's calibration, and they are also the language of capability.

activities.anchor: from that process pile up nearly normally around
activities.caption: fill the theorem that charts averages
activities.name: spcCLTCloze

config.text: Even if individual bottles vary according to some lopsided distribution, the averages of small samples pile up nearly normally, with a spread of σ divided by the %%0%% of the sample size — which is why quality work charts the %%1%% mean, not individuals.
config.hint: First blank: what you take of the sample size to narrow the spread. Second blank: the small group drawn close together in time.

activities.anchor: roughly one point in 370 crosses them by chance alone
activities.caption: bet before you read on — the excursion
activities.name: spcExcursionPredict

config.q: A point crosses the upper control limit. What have you just proven?
choices: That the pattern would be very unlikely if nothing changed — now investigate what was special
That the 1-in-370 allowance has been used up for the year
config.why: Statistics can only say 'this pattern would be very unlikely if nothing changed' — the special cause still has to be found by a human who knows the process.

activities.anchor: The chart's discipline is its restraint
activities.caption: file each pattern under signal or silence
activities.name: spcSignalBuckets

config.prompt: React only to signals — file each pattern:

items.label: a point beyond a control limit
two of three points beyond 2σ on one side
a run of eight on one side of the centre line
points scattered randomly within the limits

config.why: Each signal says the same thing in different words: something changed — go find it. A new operator, a dull tool, a different raw-material lot, a drifting sensor.

activities.anchor: Cpk adds a penalty for being off centre
activities.caption: which curve is Cpk as the mean drifts?
activities.name: spcCpkTrace

config.prompt: Spec 500 ± 2 mL, process σ = 0.5 mL (so Cp ≈ 1.33). The process mean drifts from 500 mL — which curve is Cpk?
config.why: Cpk = min((USL − μ)/3σ, (μ − LSL)/3σ): 1.33 on centre, about 1.07 at a 500.4 mL drift — the same variation, but less of it usable. Control first, capability second.

activities.anchor: the 3.4 figure prices in an assumed 1.5σ drift
activities.caption: call the margin — the six-sigma convention
activities.name: spcSigmaEstimate

config.prompt: Six sigma's headline '3.4 defects per million' is a convention that trims the six-standard-deviation margin. The effective margin is how many σ?
config.why: The convention allows for the assumed shift between short-run and long-run behaviour, trimming 6σ to 4.5σ — quoted sigma levels are shorthand for a model of how processes drift.
config.context: Six standard deviations of margin alone would compute to about two defects per billion — which is why the headline looks like an arithmetic error until you know the convention.

activities.anchor: Three currents carry this material into modern practice
activities.caption: pair each current with its move
activities.name: spcCurrentsMatch

config.prompt: SPC beyond the chart — pair each current with what it does:

pairs.right: a Gage R&R study partitions variation into part-to-part, operator and instrument components
variation thinking for whole organisations — blaming individuals for common cause is a category error
any deviation from target costs money, proportionally to its square
in-line sensors measuring every unit, and machine-learning models hunting patterns the Western Electric rules never anticipated

config.why: The constants through all of it are Shewhart's: know your noise, listen for the signal, and never mistake one for the other.
